budget_items.topic: Schools FY23 budget total and increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The schools FY23 budget totals $22,325,309, a 3.11 percent increase from FY22.
budget_items.quote: the schools fy23 budget totals $22,325,309 which is a 3.11 percent increase from fy22.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Level services cost $212,182, new positions add $193,522, salary reserve $30,000, expenses $232,913; total increase $673,617.
budget_items.quote: it will cost $212,182 to keep services level with fy22, new positions will increase the budget by $193,522

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chapter 70 funds increased with low-income student uptick and make up 39 percent of the school budget.
budget_items.quote: chapter 70 funds, which make up for 39 percent

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The schools were awarded several competitive grants covering summer school, after school, IT products and curriculum materials; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the schools were awarded several competitive grants that cover costs for summer school, after school, it products, and curriculum materials.

budget_items.topic: Assistant tax collector and clerical budget lines
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Budget reflects a $4,200 increase for the assistant tax collector, $900 for registration and census salaries and postage, $10,116 clerical assistance for Conservation, and $5,000 for an alternate Building Commissioner.
budget_items.quote: the budget reflects a $4,200 increase for the assistant tax collector

budget_items.what_was_recorded: IT budget includes a help desk system, email cloud hosting, network upgrade, VOIP phones, computer upgrades and other lines, with a MIIA grant covering part of email hosting.
budget_items.quote: $12,200 for email cloud hosting (a miia risk management grant has been received and will cover $10,000)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A 22 percent increase for both Nashoba Health and Nashoba Nursing; a $5,000 increase to the Veterans Administration salary line.
budget_items.quote: a 22 percent increase for both nashoba health and nashoba nursing

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Active employee health insurance renewal at a 5.56 percent increase totaling $43,467; retiree increase of five percent at $19,738; school retiree costs rise $57,496.
budget_items.quote: the actual health insurance renewal for active town employees came in at a 5.56 percent increase, which totals $43,467

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A 6.6 percent increase ($19,925) in Medicare costs, $450 for Montachusett Planning, $1,800 for Town Band concerts; 5 percent increase for Workers Compensation and Liability.
budget_items.quote: a 6.6 percent increase ($19,925) in medicare costs

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town debt is decreasing with no new borrowing scheduled; Primary School and Public Safety building debt paid off and dropped in FY23. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: and no new borrowing has been scheduled. the primary school and public safety building will be paid off

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Updated FY23 capital plan totals all 29 projects at $3,861,049.
budget_items.quote: bringing the total for all 29 projects to $3,861,049

budget_items.what_was_recorded: State Legislature earmarked $50,000; contract awarded to lowest responsible bidder at $44,650.
budget_items.quote: the state legislature has earmarked $50,000 to fund the school st hazardous materials abatement project

budget_items.topic: Contract award for School St abatement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Contract to Air Quality Experts as lowest, most responsive bidder at $44,650.
budget_items.quote: contract will be awarded to air quality experts, who was the lowest, most responsive bidder at $44,650.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Street light costs from Unitil are now approximately $91,300; Green Communities Committee will apply for grants to offset LED conversion.
budget_items.quote: street light costs, which are now approximately $91,300

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Full back tax amount owed on Meadow Woods property was $733,000 and has been paid in full by new owners.
budget_items.quote: the full amount owed was $733,000 and has been paid in full by new owners of the property
